The person behind the work

A reader first.
An advocate, always.

Hello, I’m Ivy.

I believe in the story
only you can tell.

I’m a literary agent drawn to distinctive voices and unforgettable stories—work that awakens imagination, invites empathy, and leaves us with something meaningful after the final page.

As a former secondary school teacher, I bring a background in encouraging young writers, studying literature, and helping storytellers strengthen their voices. That experience shapes the way I read: with curiosity, patience, and an eye for what a manuscript can become.

My Asian and Canadian heritage has given me a deep appreciation for different cultures and ways of seeing the world. I’m particularly interested in stories of identity, resilience, cultural connection, and personal transformation.
